claims: C1 the example shows a roast based on non-protected characteristics is permitted when explicitly instructed
C2 refusing such a roast request is not permitted; the refusal is marked BAD
C3 the explicit instruction in the example carries user authority

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction issued at the user authority level
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to the user instruction in the example without defining the authority level

concepts.name: roast_request
concepts.gloss: R is a request to roast the user, and I is the explicit instruction that conveys it
concepts.inference: the example's user message is an explicit instruction to roast; the relation between the request and the instruction is needed to connect the act to the authority level

asserts.read_back: refusing a roast request % is forbidden when the request is an explicit instruction at the user authority level

closure.reason: the example marks the refusal as BAD, so refusing a roast request that is explicitly instructed at user authority is prohibited; silence about other refusals is unsettled by this clause
